candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that stores double the provided amount.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that stores zero irrespective of provided amount.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that increments the current betLimit by the provided amount.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that subtracts the provided amount from the current betLimit.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that sets betLimit to amount but omit emitting the BetLimitChanged event (event removed).
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing the require check (no owner restriction), which can change who can call AdjustBetAmounts and thus who can change betLimit.
Assigns difficulty to amount + 1 instead of amount, changing stored value after AdjustDifficulty.
Subtracts 1 from amount when setting difficulty, causing a different stored value after AdjustDifficulty.
Does not change difficulty (no assignment) — keeps previous value, altering post-call observable state compared to original assignment.
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing owner check, changing who can call AdjustDifficulty and thus observable difficulty after call.
Change OpenToThePublic to set openToPublic = false instead of true, flipping the flag when called.
Make OpenToThePublic toggle the openToPublic flag (invert its current value) instead of always setting true.
Change OpenToThePublic to emit the state change by setting openToPublic to true and then immediately to false (net effect differs after call), leaving visible value different from original.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner instead of equality, inverting owner check and preventing owner from opening to public.
Replace betLimit assignment with setting betLimit to amount + 1 so AdjustBetAmounts results in a different public bet limit.
Replace betLimit assignment with setting betLimit to amount - 1 (underflow/checked by solidity will revert if amount == 0), altering observable bet limit after call.
Swap the order: emit event before assigning betLimit so observers see event carrying previous value rather than new one.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to use a strict revert message on failure, changing external revert behavior when non-owner calls AdjustBetAmounts.
Change onlyOwner to require msg.sender == whale instead of owner, so AdjustBetAmounts can only be called by whale, altering who can change the public bet limit.
Replace setting difficulty with setting to zero (assign 0) so AdjustDifficulty changes stored difficulty value differently.
Replace assignment to difficulty with assigning amount+1, so the stored difficulty after call differs from original amount.

Remove the require checking owner in onlyOwner modifier by changing it to require false, preventing owner-only functions (including AdjustDifficulty) from succeeding and thus changing observable behavior.
Alter onlyOwner to allow anyone (remove ownership check) so AdjustDifficulty can be called by non-owners, changing who can observe different difficulty.
Change required wager amount check from equality to <= so a different set of calls can set wagers[msg.sender], altering wagers state after wager() completes.
Remove the guard that prevents re-wagering by deleting the require that wagers[msg.sender] == 0 so repeated wagers overwrite wagers[msg.sender].
Set wagers[msg.sender] to betLimit instead of msg.value so the stored wager differs when msg.value != betLimit.
Relax onlyRealPeople check to allow contracts by removing tx.origin comparison so contract callers can set wagers leading to different wagers state.
Invert isOpenToPublic check to require not openToPublic so wager can only be called when closed, changing whether wagers[msg.sender] gets set in sequences.
